content.name: Good-supervised LoRA plus official masked Sana inpainting, with frozen scorer auxiliary ranking
content.authorization: User: 做我们之前说的lora下的inpainting优化，使用这个模型辅助判别
content.training: Native continuous flow: z_t=(1-t)*encode(Good)+t*epsilon, target=epsilon-encode(Good), t uniform[.001,1]. Original unchanged prompt; mask-area-normalized MSE plus .05 background MSE. Only LoRA gradients. No scorer loss/weighting/pseudo labels.
content.mask: Original uint8 mask bilinear to32x32 then>.5 exactly as earlier official inpainting; pixel mask original>0, no dilation or feathering.
content.inference: Verbatim official sample_mask:20 forward steps+19 inversion, CFG4.5 flow_shift3; LoRA enabled for BOTH inverse and forward, one Sana. Fresh seeded noise; no Good input. Original-mask hard pixel composite and raw PNG both retained.

evaluation.final: 512:all8dev10seeds and first8train2seeds; original baseline same seeds, prompts, masks. All outputs frozen before scorer ranking.
evaluation.baseline: Reuse prior80 official originals only after3 exact actual PNG replay probes; otherwise fail, do not relax.
evaluation.scorer: Frozen unified scorer; score all candidates and report same-seed changes and per-grouptop1. High score is not anatomy success. Display all seeds, no hidden failures.

content.differences_from_old: Old fm128 used halo1 maxpool mask, hybrid latent target, partial sigma.6 sampling. Here Good latent is not pasted twice; original official mask, full-noise official inverse+inpaint evaluation,512 updates. Recipe changes are bundled; cannot attribute any gain to one factor. Prior endpoint/bridge/210 and mask-channel designs remain stopped.
content.limits: Strengthens Good generation prior; does not directly learn a Bad-to-Good conditional editor. No proof of transfer or success. Existing dev8 repeatedly viewed, not blind. confirm32 untouched.
content.stop: 512 attempted updates hard cap. Fail on nonfinite values or any skipped optimizer update, parity/hash failure; no automatic expansion. Human success rate remains null.
